newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen oil income up to $958 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Yemen oil income up to $958 mln in 1996.

text.p: Yemen's income from oil exports rose to $958.4 million in 1996 up from $777.5 million in 1995, an Oil Ministry official said on Thursday.

He said the government's share of crude produced in Yemen in 1996 reached 28.76 million barrels for local consumption compared to 24.43 million in 1995. The government's share for export stood at 47.03 million barrels compared to 45.89 million barrels in 1995.
Total production in non-OPEC Yemen is currently running at some 365,000 barrells per day, some of which goes to foreign joint venture operators.
